name: Church123
shortDescription: A UK church website builder and managed hosting service with templates, a browser-based editor, member pages, podcasting, media storage and UK support.
suitableContexts: Churches wanting a managed, template-led website without needing web-development skills
Churches that need church-specific member pages, audio sermon publishing and media libraries
Teams that value UK phone and email support alongside a browser-based editor

pricing.summary: Church123 publishes UK Webbuilder pricing of £49 per quarter or £195 per year, plus VAT, with an optional domain cost. The supplier says the package includes hosting, templates, editing, 4GB media storage, helpdesk support and regular backups. Confirm any bespoke work, extra storage and renewal costs in writing.

dataHosting: Church123 states that its webbuilder includes hosting, 4GB storage, regular site backups and a nightly-backup aim in its current terms. The reviewed public sources do not establish data-centre location, cloud provider, sub-processors, recovery objectives, service-level commitments or separate arrangements for personal information; obtain these before using member pages or contact forms for sensitive data.
gdprInformation: A current Church123 privacy notice and service-specific data-processing agreement were not available in the reviewed public sources. The service can include member pages and contact information, so a church should obtain controller/processor roles, security detail, sub-processor list, retention, cookies, incident process and data-subject request procedures in writing before publishing or collecting personal data.

gbp-pricing.value: Church123 publishes UK webbuilder prices of £49 quarterly or £195 annually, plus VAT, and .org.uk or .co.uk domains at £8 annually.

hosting-and-backup.value: Supplier publishes managed hosting, 4GB storage, regular backups and a nightly-backup aim; complete infrastructure and recovery detail is not established in this profile.

data-processing.value: Current Church123 DPA, privacy notice, data-storage geography and sub-processor documentation are not available in the reviewed public material.

exit.value: Terms say the supplier will aim to delete a website within 30 days of cancellation, but website-content export, domain transfer, redirects and media-archive exit arrangements are not established in this profile.

editorial.assessment: Church123 is an established UK managed website option for a church that wants to publish content, sermons and member pages without maintaining its own hosting stack. Its transparent annual price and trial make it practical to assess. Because a public church website can quickly become a repository for contacts, forms and member content, the key decision is not the template choice: it is whether the current data, domain and exit terms fit the church's governance requirements.
bestFor: Churches wanting an established, church-specific managed website builder
Small teams who need telephone-backed support and a straightforward CMS
Churches publishing audio sermons, resources and member-only pages
strengths: UK operator, current service terms and published GBP price
Managed hosting, templates, editing and backup commitments are stated
Church-specific content scope including podcasting and member pages
30-day free trial and UK weekday support
limitations: Ask for current documentation covering hosting location, security architecture, the DPA, cookies, sub-processors and retention
Confirm content export, domain transfer, redirects and media migration before treating the site as a long-term archive
Bespoke template work, large storage requirements and domain costs may add to the base price
Terms contain content restrictions that a church should review against its editorial independence and governance
